reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fix `flux push artifact` for insecure registries by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5449", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: `flux push artifact` now works against insecure registries where it previously failed; nothing breaks and no operator action is required — the fix only removes the failure.
consequence.remediation: none; environments pushing to insecure registries simply get the corrected behavior after upgrading the flux CLI to 2.7.0

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 fixes the `flux push artifact` CLI command so that it works with insecure registries, where it previously failed.
